title: Reshape ADR-001 to ADR-012 to Peer AI 1.0's decision template
goal: The eight ADR files split into two formats. ADR-013 follows Peer AI 1.0's decision template and check_document accepts it; ADR-001 to ADR-012 use v0's project format, with Status in a field table and Alternatives Considered in place of Options, and check_document rejects all of them. Reshape the headings only, never a word of the reasoning or a decision, so every record is checkable.
acceptance: Given each file in docs/adr, when check_document runs with skill architecture and template decision, then every one is ready
Given any amended record, when its text is compared with the version before the reshape, then no sentence of context, decision, alternative or consequence has changed — only headings moved
Given ADR-003 to ADR-007, which live inside docs/02-architecture.md rather than as files, when the reshape is done, then it states whether they stay there or become files, and why

reviews.summary: Pass. All three criteria hold on evidence rather than assertion: all eight ADR files accepted where seven were rejected; the complete diff is fifteen heading lines and nothing else, counted against git, so no reasoning could have changed; and the ADR-003 to ADR-007 answer is recorded beside the table it concerns, with ITEM-7 carrying the work. TEST-09 is satisfied by the checker having been seen to reject these same files first.

requiredReviews.reason: its work item has acceptance criteria, which must all hold before it ships
